_comment: Tier-1 Shapiro-Wilk (Shapiro-Francia variant) normality check on revenue, split by treatment. The cohort's revenue is log-normal by construction, so the test should reject normality for both control and variant. Pair with the parametric A/B-test battery as a pre-flight gate: if Shapiro rejects, prefer the nonparametric Mann-Whitney over the parametric t-test.
